entries.complaint: "ISO" almost universally means the International Organization for Standardization to a Czech technical reader, not the (US) Insurance Services Office this string means. The English spells out "Insurance Services Office (ISO)" so an English reader is warned, but the abbreviation alone in a Czech sentence risks being read as an ISO standard reference instead of a US insurance-industry credit rule.
readings: Translated literally, keeping ISO and trusting the parenthetical to disambiguate, as in English
Add a short clarifying gloss (e.g. "americká pojišťovací organizace") so the sentence cannot be misread as citing an ISO standard
